ecoplug_select.title: Select ecoPlug
ecoplug_select.description:
Each selected plug creates:

- An on/off switch
- A real-time power sensor (W)
- A total energy sensor (kWh)

ecomain_cloud_confirm.title: Confirm Device
ecomain_cloud_confirm.description:
Serial Number: {ecomain_serial}

- `*_energy_total_1m`: raw 1-minute energy increment from the cloud API.
- Use `*_energy_accumulated` for the Home Assistant Energy Dashboard.
- Cloud accumulated energy is an estimate: the API provides no timestamp or sample ID for each value.

measurement_types.title: Measurement Types
measurement_types.description:
- Select at least one measurement type to create.
- Types used by extra entities cannot be deselected.
- Local firmware 136–138: active power and forward/reverse active energy.
- Local firmware 139 or later: also supports the eight additional types and channel phase settings.
- Unsupported types are hidden on older firmware.

extra_formula.title: Add Formula Entity
extra_formula.description:
- Select sources; the next page shows their variables.
- Editing cannot change the result type. Create a new entity to change it.

extra_formula_expression.title: Expression
extra_formula_expression.description:
Variables: {variables}

- Supports +, -, *, /, parentheses, abs, min, max and round.
- Examples: `max(a-b,0)`, `(a+b)/2`.
- The result type sets the unit. Check that the formula produces a matching unit.
